description: Source code for cellular manager bus utilities, including functions for getting and setting component info and parameters via D-Bus and PSM.

methods.name: CellularMgr_RdkBus_GetComponentInfo
methods.description: Retrieves component name and D-Bus path supporting a given parameter name.

methods.name: CellularMgr_RdkBus_SetParamValue
methods.description: Sets a parameter value for a specified component and path.

methods.name: CellularMgr_RdkBus_GetParamValue
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from a specified component and path.

methods.name: CellularMgr_RdkBus_GetParamValuesFromDB
methods.description: Reads a parameter value from the PSM database.

methods.name: CellularMgr_RdkBus_SetParamValuesToDB
methods.description: Writes a parameter value to the PSM database.
